title: Loquat Madness
body:
**Loquat Madness** is a Minecraft mod about loquats that expand their uses and capabilities, up to bizarre _amalgamations_.

Expand on your knowledge of loquats by _infusing_ them with amethyst crystals, so you can create the different and useful tools that the mod provides: such as combat, meals and farming!

Be careful with loquats, you don't fully know them...



🌱 **How to progress?** 🌱

You can reach into the **Advancements** to have a clear guide of what you can do with the loquats! If you have any trouble finding a loquat tree, don't worry because they appear **everywhere** on the overworld surface, so keep on searching.



📖 **Supported languages** 📖

- English
- Spanish

📌 **Versions and Mod loaders** 📌

At the time the mod is only available in **NeoForge** on Minecraft versions from **26.1.2+**, but we'll try to get this mod to other loaders and minecraft versions for you to enjoy.

This mod supports other generation mods, such as _Biomes O' Plenty_.
